sEn: Anthropic staff and the US public agree on AI's current capabilities but diverge sharply on its future pace, and this gap in capability expectations—not differing theories of labor-market impact—drives disagreement about AI's economic effects.
sZh: Anthropic 员工与美国公众对 AI 当前能力看法一致，但对未来进展速度分歧巨大，正是这种能力预期的差距——而非对劳动力市场影响的不同理论——导致了关于 AI 经济影响的分歧。
absEn: This note presents survey evidence from August 2026 comparing a nationally representative sample of US adults with Anthropic staff on expectations about AI's economic impact. Both groups largely agree on what AI can do today but diverge sharply on the pace of future progress: 91% of Anthropic staff expect AI to make a Nobel-level discovery by 2030, compared with 39% of US adults, and staff expect AI to perform 75% of their current work by 2030 versus 28% for US workers. Despite these differences in capability expectations, the two groups reason similarly about the labor market: people who expect AI to do more of their own work forecast higher unemployment, and at the same level of expected automation both groups forecast about the same unemployment rate. The authors conclude that disagreement about AI's economic impact stems less from different theories of how AI affects jobs than from different experiences of AI capabilities, with staff anticipating faster diffusion and larger productivity gains while still expecting their employer to keep hiring.
absZh: 本简报呈现了 2026 年 8 月的调查证据，比较了具有全国代表性的美国成年人样本与 Anthropic 员工对 AI 经济影响的预期。两组人群对 AI 当前能力的看法基本一致，但对未来进展速度的看法存在显著分歧：91%的 Anthropic 员工预计 AI 将在 2030 年前做出诺贝尔奖级别的发现，而美国成年人中这一比例为 39%；员工预计到 2030 年 AI 将完成其当前工作的 75%，而美国劳动者预计这一比例为 28%。尽管在能力预期上存在这些差异，两组人群对劳动力市场的推理方式却相似：越预期 AI 能完成自己更多工作的人，越预测失业率会更高；而在相同的预期自动化水平下，两组人群预测的失业率大致相同。作者得出结论：关于 AI 经济影响的分歧，与其说源于对 AI 如何影响就业的不同理论，不如说源于对 AI 能力的不同体验——员工预期 AI 扩散更快、生产率提升更大，但仍预计其雇主会继续招聘。

paras.en: * 08 对 AI 的预期及其经济影响
paras.zh: * 08 对 AI 的预期及其经济影响

paras.en: _Szymon Sacher, Tess Cotter, Charles I. Jones, Anton Korinek, Peter McCrory_
paras.zh: _Szymon Sacher, Tess Cotter, Charles I. Jones, Anton Korinek, Peter McCrory_

paras.en: 1. US adults expect AI capabilities to advance rapidly in the coming years; Anthropic staff expect even faster progress; 39% of US adults and 91% of staff expect that AI will be able to make a Nobel-level discovery by 2030.
paras.zh: 1. 美国成年人预期 AI 能力在未来几年将快速提升；Anthropic 员工则预期进展更快；39% 的美国成年人和 91% 的员工认为，到 2030 年 AI 将能够做出诺贝尔奖级别的发现。

paras.en: 2. Anthropic staff expect much larger productivity gains from AI on the tasks it is well-suited for. Among US adults who use AI at work, 26% say a task takes a quarter of the time or less with AI, compared to 59% of Anthropic staff.
paras.zh: 2. Anthropic 员工预期 AI 在其擅长的任务上会带来更大的生产力提升。在使用 AI 工作的美国成年人中，26% 表示某项任务借助 AI 只需原时间的四分之一或更少，而 Anthropic 员工中这一比例为 59%。

paras.en: 3. When it comes to their own job, over half of Anthropic staff expect AI to be able to do at least 80% of their current work by 2030, compared with 5% of US workers.
paras.zh: 3. 就自身工作而言，超过一半的 Anthropic 员工预期到 2030 年 AI 至少能完成其当前工作的 80%，而美国劳动者中这一比例仅为 5%。

paras.en: 4. Among both US workers and Anthropic staff, people who expect AI to do more of their own work anticipate higher unemployment. While there are differences in beliefs about future capabilities, the perceived link between how AI might change one's own job and broader unemployment is very similar for both groups.
paras.zh: 4. 在美国劳动者和 Anthropic 员工两个群体中，预期 AI 能承担更多自身工作的人也更预期失业率上升。尽管双方对未来能力的看法存在差异，但两个群体对于 AI 可能如何改变自身工作与更广泛失业之间关联的感知非常相似。

paras.en: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, and the possibility that future AI models may be able to build their own successors (recursive self-improvement) could further accelerate the rate of progress. How quickly this might materialize and to what extent is unclear. Forecasts vary widely and are fiercely debated.
paras.zh: 未来几年，AI 将如何重塑经济？AI 能力正在快速提升，而未来 AI 模型可能能够构建自己的后继者（递归自我改进）这一可能性，可能进一步加速进步的速度。这可能在多快实现以及在多大程度上实现尚不清楚。预测差异很大，并且争论激烈。

paras.en: What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? Is it principally due to differences in beliefs about how quickly AI capabilities will improve? Or does it reflect disagreement about how quickly and in what form those capabilities translate to real-world adoption? Which views on the future path of AI are consistent with rapid economic growth?
paras.zh: 关于 AI 未来对经济影响的分歧核心来源是什么？主要由于对 AI 能力提升速度的信念差异？还是反映了关于这些能力以多快速度、以何种形式转化为现实世界应用的分歧？哪些关于 AI 未来路径的观点与快速经济增长相一致？

paras.en: This note presents new survey evidence on these questions. In August 2026, we surveyed two groups: a sample of US adults that was nationally representative and Anthropic staff.¹ The questions covered, among other things, AI's capabilities, how widely it will be used, how much time it saves, how autonomous it will be, and how difficult it will be for a displaced worker to find a job in a different occupation.² Anthropic staff build and use frontier AI every day. The second survey therefore shows how people closest to the technology anticipate its future, both in capabilities and in broader economic impact.
paras.zh: 本报告呈现了关于这些问题的新的调查证据。2026 年 8 月，我们调查了两组人群：一个全国代表性的美国成年人样本和 Anthropic 员工。¹ 问题涵盖 AI 的能力、其将被使用的广泛程度、节省多少时间、自主性程度，以及流离失所的工人找到不同职业工作的难度。² Anthropic 员工每天构建和使用前沿模型。因此，第二项调查显示了最接近该技术的人们如何预期其未来，包括能力和更广泛的经济影响。

paras.en: We report the following main findings. First, the two groups largely agree about what AI can do today but disagree about the pace of future progress. Anthropic staff expect capabilities to advance faster, AI to be used more widely and with less human involvement, and the time it saves on a task to be much larger. For example, 91% of staff expect AI to be able to make a Nobel-level discovery by 2030, compared to 39% of US adults.
paras.zh: 我们报告以下主要发现。第一，两组人群对 AI 今天能做什么大体一致，但对未来进步的速度存在分歧。Anthropic 员工预期能力提升更快，AI 将被更广泛使用且人类参与更少，任务上节省的时间更大。例如，91% 的员工预期到 2030 年 AI 能够做出诺贝尔奖级别的发现，而美国成年人中这一比例为 39%。

paras.en: Second, there are sharp differences concerning people's own jobs. On average, staff members expect AI to be able to do 75% of their current work by 2030, compared to 28% for US workers overall.
paras.zh: 第二，关于人们自己的工作，存在尖锐差异。平均而言，员工预期到 2030 年 AI 能够完成他们当前工作的 75%，而美国工人总体中这一比例为 28%。

paras.en: Third, the two groups seem to reason about the labor market in a similar way: people who expect AI to do more of their own work in the future forecast higher unemployment. And, at the same level of expected AI automation of their own work, both groups forecast about the same unemployment rate.
paras.zh: 第三，这两个群体似乎以相似的方式对劳动力市场进行推理：预期 AI 未来会承担自己更多工作的人，会预测更高的失业率。并且，在预期 AI 对自身工作的自动化程度相同时，两个群体预测的失业率大致相同。

items.en: We first investigate expectations about AI capabilities. We asked when AI will be able to do each of eight tasks as well as a skilled professional, from writing routine emails to making a Nobel-level scientific discovery. US adults and Anthropic staff largely agree on what AI can do today, particularly when it comes to more complex tasks. Both groups rank tasks in nearly the same order of difficulty (Figure 1, panel A).
items.zh: 我们首先考察人们对 AI 能力的预期。我们询问了 AI 何时能够像熟练专业人士一样完成八项任务中的每一项，从撰写日常邮件到做出诺贝尔级别的科学发现。美国成年人与 Anthropic 员工对 AI 当前能做什么基本一致，尤其是在更复杂的任务上。两组对任务难度的排序几乎相同（图 1，面板 A）。

items.en: The groups disagree on the path of future AI progress. For example, around a quarter of US adults and Anthropic staff think that AI can design, conduct, and publish scientific studies today. But by next year, 9 in 10 staff expect this to be feasible for AI as compared to just 38% for the general public. By 2030, 39% of US adults expect AI to be able to make a Nobel-level discovery (panel C), compared with 91% of staff. What is perhaps the most striking difference, depending on the task, between 19 and 40% of US adults say AI will _never_ be able to do a given task, compared with at most 2% of staff.
items.zh: 两组对未来 AI 进展的路径存在分歧。例如，约四分之一的美国成年人和 Anthropic 员工认为 AI 今天就能设计、开展并发表科学研究。但到明年，十分之九的员工预期 AI 能做到这一点，而普通公众中这一比例仅为 38%。到 2030 年，39% 的美国成年人预期 AI 能够做出诺贝尔级别的发现（面板 C），而员工中这一比例为 91%。或许最显著的差异在于，视任务而定，19% 至 40% 的美国成年人表示 AI _永远_ 无法完成某项任务，而员工中这一比例至多为 2%。

items.en: In part, differences in views reflect differences in frequency of AI use. Among those who use AI at work regularly (about a fifth of respondents), 56% expect AI to be able to do at least seven of the eight named tasks by 2030. This is substantially higher than among all US adults (41%) and among those who have never used an AI tool (28%), but still well short of the staff view (96%).
items.zh: 观点差异部分反映了 AI 使用频率的差异。在经常在工作中使用 AI 的人（约占受访者的五分之一）中，56% 预期到 2030 年 AI 至少能完成八项指定任务中的七项。这显著高于全体美国成年人（41%）以及从未使用过 AI 工具的人（28%），但仍远低于员工的看法（96%）。

items.capEn: Share of respondents who expect AI to be able to complete the listed tasks as well as a skilled professional.** Respondents were asked when AI will be able to complete these tasks, regardless of whether companies will actually use it. Panels show the share answering (A) already, (B) by 2027, and (C) by 2030. US adults’ responses (N=10,980) are weighted to be nationally representative, Anthropic staff responses are unweighted.
items.capZh: 预计 AI 能像熟练专业人员一样完成所列任务的受访者比例。** 受访者被问及 AI 何时能完成这些任务，无论公司是否实际会使用。分图显示回答（A）已经、（B）到 2027 年、（C）到 2030 年的比例。美国成年人回答（N=10,980）经加权以具全国代表性，Anthropic 员工回答未加权。

items.en: The impact of AI on the economy is not solely determined by raw capabilities. People and businesses need to actually use AI, which takes time and experimentation. Of the work tasks AI will be able to do, US adults expect that 42% will be done with AI by 2030. Anthropic staff expect noticeably faster diffusion over the next few years, with AI used for 65% of all tasks for which it could be used.
items.zh: AI 对经济的影响并不完全由原始能力决定。人们和企业需要真正使用 AI，而这需要时间和试验。在 AI 将能够完成的工作任务中，美国成年人预计到 2030 年将有 42% 由 AI 完成。Anthropic 员工预计未来几年扩散速度将明显更快，在 AI 能够胜任的所有任务中，将有 65% 由 AI 完成。

items.en: To understand what might hold back AI adoption at work, we asked US adults to choose up to three obstacles from a list of nine that they expect to be the biggest. The general public expects that people's preferences and rules, more than the technological constraints, may be what holds adoption back (Figure 2). "Customers preferring to deal with a person" was the obstacle selected most often, followed by "data privacy and security concerns," "AI not being reliable enough," and "laws, regulations or liability."
items.zh: 为了解哪些因素可能阻碍 AI 在工作中的采用，我们请美国成年人从九项障碍中选出他们预计最大的至多三项。公众预计，相比技术限制，人们的偏好和规则可能才是阻碍采用的因素（图 2）。“客户更愿意与人打交道”是选择最多的障碍，其次是“数据隐私和安全担忧”、“AI 不够可靠”以及“法律、法规或责任”。

items.capEn: Obstacles to AI use at work in 2030 named by US adults.** Respondents were told that businesses do not always use AI even when it is technically capable of doing a task, and were asked which of nine obstacles will be the biggest to AI being used at work in 2030. Each could choose up to three, so shares sum to more than 100%. We did not ask this question to Anthropic staff.
items.capZh: 美国成年人指出的 2030 年工作中使用 AI 的障碍。** 受访者被告知企业即使 AI 技术上能完成任务也并不总是使用，并被问及九种障碍中哪种将是 2030 年工作中使用 AI 的最大障碍。每人最多可选三项，因此比例总和超过 100%。我们未向 Anthropic 员工询问此问题。

items.en: Notably, US adults who use AI regularly at work rank data privacy and security concerns first (42% consider it among the top three obstacles, compared with 37% among the rest) and see customer preferences to deal with humans as slightly less important (37% vs. 42%).
items.zh: 值得注意的是，在工作中经常使用 AI 的美国成年人将数据隐私和安全担忧排在首位（42% 认为它是前三大障碍之一，而其余人群为 37%），并认为客户更愿意与人打交道的偏好略不重要（37% 对 42%）。

full.secZh: 自主 AI 将如何发展

items.en: The impact of AI on the labor market will in part depend on whether AI completes complex tasks autonomously or in collaboration with a human. The former tends to displace human workers. Alternatively, when AI complements human capabilities, workers become more productive. To get a sense for anticipated automation versus augmentation in 2030 among Anthropic staff and the general public, we asked how AI and humans will work together on various tasks ranging from email drafting to legal contracting by 2030. At Anthropic, the vast majority of staff say that by 2030 AI will either complete tasks alone or with a worker evaluating the work (Figure 3). By contrast, 4 in 10 US adults instead expect that humans will do most of the work themselves or with some AI help.
items.zh: AI 对劳动力市场的影响，部分取决于 AI 是自主完成复杂任务，还是与人类协作完成。前者往往取代人类工作者。反之，当 AI 补充人类能力时，工作者的生产力会提高。为了解 Anthropic 员工与公众对 2030 年自动化与增强的预期，我们询问了到 2030 年 AI 与人类将如何在从邮件起草到法律合同等各种任务上协同工作。在 Anthropic，绝大多数员工表示，到 2030 年 AI 将要么独自完成任务，要么由一名工作者评估其工作（图 3）。相比之下，40% 的美国成年人反而预期，大部分工作将由人类自己完成，或仅借助少量 AI 帮助。

items.capEn: Share of respondents who expect AI to do each task alone or with a worker checking.** Respondents were asked to imagine that AI is useful for each of the five tasks and asked who will be doing them: AI alone; AI does most of it, with workers checking; workers do most of it, with AI helping; or workers alone. Bars show the share choosing either of the first two.
items.capZh: 预计 AI 单独或由工人检查完成每项任务的受访者比例。** 受访者被要求设想 AI 对五项任务各有用途，并询问将由谁完成：AI 单独；AI 完成大部分，工人检查；工人完成大部分，AI 协助；或仅工人。条形图显示选择前两项的比例。

items.en: How much AI raises output depends not only on which tasks it can do and how widely it is used, but also on how much faster and better it does them. A technology that is just good enough to replace workers—what Acemoglu and Restrepo (2019) call a "so-so" technology—displaces work without much increase in GDP. By contrast, a technology that completes tasks at a small fraction of cost or in a fraction of time can meaningfully raise GDP.
items.zh: AI 提高产出的程度不仅取决于它能完成哪些任务以及其使用范围有多广，还取决于它完成任务的速度和效果提升了多少。一项仅够替代工人的技术——Acemoglu 和 Restrepo (2019) 称之为“平庸”技术——会取代工作，但不会大幅增加 GDP。相比之下，一项能以极小的成本或极短的时间完成任务的技术，则能显著提高 GDP。

items.en: To measure perceptions about the productivity lift from AI, we asked the general public and Anthropic staff how long a task for which AI is well suited takes with AI, compared with doing it without AI. A task done in half the time corresponds to a doubling of output per hour.3
items.zh: 为了衡量公众对 AI 带来的生产力提升的感知，我们询问了公众和 Anthropic 员工：对于一项 AI 非常擅长的任务，使用 AI 完成所需的时间与不使用 AI 相比如何。一项任务如果完成时间减半，就相当于每小时产出翻倍。3

items.en: Anthropic staff report much larger expected savings, with 85% saying that it takes half the time or less. Among US adults who use AI at work, the typical answer is half the time, and 29% say the task takes just as long or longer, while only 5% of staff say so. Among US adults, 26% of those who use AI at work say a task takes a quarter of the time or less, and 21% of those who do not use AI at work say the same. For staff, that share is 59% (Figure 4).
items.zh: Anthropic 员工报告的预期节省要大得多，85% 的人表示只需一半或更少的时间。在使用 AI 工作的美国成年人中，典型答案是时间减半，29% 的人表示任务耗时相同或更长，而员工中只有 5% 的人这么认为。在美国成年人中，使用 AI 工作的人有 26% 表示任务耗时仅为四分之一或更少，而不使用 AI 工作的人中这一比例为 21%。对于员工，这一比例是 59%（图 4）。

items.en: Staff may be describing what they experience at work. As discussed further in _How Employment is Changing at Anthropic_, Anthropic employees increased productivity on some dimensions after adopting agentic tools: the lines of code engineers added tripled in the month after adopting coding agents and sales representatives closed more deals with clients after adopting AI agents. Output per person also rose in other business functions, like legal and recruiting.
items.zh: 员工可能描述的是他们在工作中的实际体验。正如在《Anthropic 的就业如何变化》中进一步讨论的那样，Anthropic 员工在采用智能体式工具后，在某些维度上提高了生产力：工程师在采用编码智能体后的一个月内添加的代码行数增加了两倍，销售代表在采用 AI 智能体后与客户达成了更多交易。其他业务职能（如法律和招聘）的人均产出也有所上升。

items.capEn: Share of respondents who say a task takes a quarter of the time or less with AI.** Respondents were asked to think of a task that today's AI is well suited for, such as summarizing a document or drafting an email, and how long it takes to finish using AI, counting the time spent checking and fixing its work, compared with not using AI. Bars show the share answering "about a quarter of the time" or "about a tenth of the time or less." Figure A2 shows all answers.
items.capZh: 表示使用 AI 后任务耗时降至四分之一或更少的受访者比例。** 受访者被要求想一项当今 AI 很适合的任务，如总结文档或起草邮件，并考虑使用 AI 完成所需时间（包括检查和修正其工作的时间），与不使用 AI 相比。条形图显示回答“约四分之一时间”或“约十分之一时间或更少”的比例。图 A2 显示所有回答。

full.sec: How much of their own work AI will be able to do
full.secZh: AI 能完成自身工作的比例

items.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly, we find a large gap in perceptions between the general public and Anthropic staff when it comes to AI's impact on their own jobs (Figure 5). On average, Anthropic staff members say AI will be able to do 75% of their current work hours by 2030. US workers (respondents who report having a job) put the share at 28% on average, and only 1 in 20 say that AI could do 80% or more of their work hours by 2030.
items.zh: 或许并不令人意外的是，在 AI 对自身工作的影响这一问题上，普通公众与 Anthropic 员工的看法存在很大差距（图 5）。平均而言，Anthropic 员工认为到 2030 年 AI 将能完成他们当前 75% 的工作时长。美国劳动者（报告自己有工作的受访者）给出的平均比例为 28%，且仅有 1/20 的人认为到 2030 年 AI 能完成其 80% 或更多的工作时长。

items.en: Across US workers, expectations vary by occupation: AI is expected to be able to do 25% of work hours among manual trades, production and transport workers and 33% for workers in computer, engineering, and science occupations. For this latter group, those who use AI regularly expect only 40%, a belief that is closer to the average US worker than to the average Anthropic staff member (75%).
items.zh: 在美国劳动者中，预期因职业而异：体力行业、生产与运输行业的劳动者认为 AI 将能完成 25% 的工作时长，而计算机、工程与科学类职业的劳动者则给出 33%。对于后一组人群，经常使用 AI 的人仅预期 40%，这一看法更接近美国劳动者的平均水平，而非 Anthropic 员工的平均水平（75%）。

items.capEn: Share of their own work hours that respondents expect AI to be able to do by 2030.**Share of the respondent's current work hours that AI will be able to do by 2030. The US adults sample is restricted to employed respondents only. Staff answered on a slider while US adults choose a range and we use range midpoints. Bars show 95% confidence intervals.
items.capZh: 受访者预计到 2030 年 AI 能完成其自身工作小时数的比例。** AI 到 2030 年能完成的受访者当前工作小时数比例。美国成年人样本仅限在职受访者。员工通过滑块回答，美国成年人选择范围，我们取范围中点。条形图显示 95%置信区间。

full.secZh: 自身工作暴露度与失业预测

items.en: How much of their own work people expect AI to do goes a long way toward explaining what they expect for the labor market. We told respondents that the current unemployment rate was about 4.2% and asked them to forecast the rate in 2030. Figure 6 groups respondents by the share of their own hours they expect AI to be able to do by 2030, and shows each group's average unemployment rate forecast.
items.zh: 人们预期 AI 能完成多少自己的工作，在很大程度上解释了他们对劳动力市场的预期。我们告知受访者当前失业率约为 4.2%，并要求他们预测 2030 年的失业率。图 6 根据受访者预期到 2030 年 AI 能完成其工作小时数的比例对受访者进行分组，并展示了各组的平均失业率预测。

items.en: US workers who expect AI to be able to do less than half of their work forecast unemployment of 7 to 8%. Above half, the forecast increases with the share of AI-exposed work. Those who expect AI to do 80% or more of their work expect, on average, an unemployment rate of 12.2% in 2030, above its peak during the Great Financial Crisis. Across US workers, ten more percentage points of work affected is associated with 0.4 points more forecasted unemployment. General optimism about AI does not explain this. Holding their own work exposure fixed, the share of the eight tasks a worker expects AI to master is unrelated to the forecast.
items.zh: 预期 AI 能完成不到一半工作的美国工人预测失业率为 7% 至 8%。超过一半时，预测值随着 AI 暴露工作比例的增加而上升。那些预期 AI 能完成 80% 或更多工作的人平均预测 2030 年失业率为 12.2%，高于大金融危机期间的峰值。在美国工人中，受影响工作比例每增加十个百分点，预测失业率就增加 0.4 个百分点。对 AI 的普遍乐观情绪并不能解释这一点。在控制自身工作暴露度不变的情况下，工人预期 AI 能掌握的八项任务的比例与预测无关。

items.en: Even though their own reported exposure is much higher, the same gradient appears among Anthropic staff, with forecasts closely mirroring those of the general population. Therefore, these two groups do not seem to hold different theories of how AI will simultaneously affect their own jobs and the broader labor market. They have different experiences of what AI capabilities are and, in turn, expectations.
items.zh: 尽管 Anthropic 员工自我报告的暴露度要高得多，但同样的梯度也出现在他们当中，其预测与普通人群的预测非常接近。因此，这两个群体似乎并不持有关于 AI 如何同时影响自身工作和更广泛劳动力市场的不同理论。他们对 AI 能力有不同的经验，进而有不同的预期。

items.capEn: Mean forecast of the 2030 unemployment rate, by the share of their own work hours that respondents expect AI to be able to do.** Respondents were told that the US unemployment rate is 4.2% today and asked what they expect it to be in 2030. Panel (A) groups employed respondents by the share of their current work hours they expect AI to be able to do by 2030, and shows each group's mean forecast and 95% confidence interval. Groups with fewer than 20 respondents are omitted. Panel (B) shows the share of US workers and of Anthropic staff in each group.
items.capZh: 按受访者预计 AI 能完成其自身工作小时数比例划分的 2030 年失业率平均预测。** 受访者被告知当前美国失业率为 4.2%，并被问及预计 2030 年是多少。图（A）按预计到 2030 年 AI 能完成当前工作小时数比例将在职受访者分组，显示各组平均预测和 95%置信区间。少于 20 名受访者的组被省略。图（B）显示各组美国工人和 Anthropic 员工的比例。

paras.en: Even though Anthropic staff expect AI to be able to do most of their work, they also expect Anthropic to keep hiring. 95% of Anthropic staff expect headcount to grow over the next 12 months, the median staff member expects it to grow by 66%, and 27% expect it at least to double. These are the personal expectations of staff members in an internal poll and do not represent Anthropic's plans or its view of its headcount. Even so, they show that automating tasks and shedding jobs are different forecasts, at least at a frontier AI lab.
paras.zh: 尽管 Anthropic 员工预期 AI 能够完成他们的大部分工作，他们同时也预期 Anthropic 会继续招聘。95% 的 Anthropic 员工预计未来 12 个月员工人数将增长，员工中位数预期增长 66%，27% 的人预期至少翻倍。这些是员工在一次内部民意调查中的个人预期，并不代表 Anthropic 的计划或其对自己员工人数的看法。即便如此，它们表明任务自动化与裁减岗位是不同的预测，至少在一家前沿 AI 实验室是如此。

paras.en: Anthropic staff, however, are slightly more pessimistic than US adults about how quickly workers displaced by AI can find new work. We asked how long it would take a person who loses their job to AI automation in 2030—and who needs to switch occupations—to find a new one.4 The median Anthropic staff member expects that a worker displaced by AI would take 12 months to find a role in a new occupation. This compares to the median US adult response in the range of 7-12 months.
paras.zh: 然而，对于被 AI 取代的劳动者能多快找到新工作，Anthropic 员工比美国成年人略为悲观。我们询问了一个在 2030 年因 AI 自动化而失去工作、并且需要转换职业的人，需要多长时间才能找到新工作。⁴ Anthropic 员工的中位数预期是，被 AI 取代的劳动者需要 12 个月才能在新职业中找到职位。相比之下，美国成年人回答的中位数在 7–12 个月区间。

full.sec: Mapping survey responses to model-implied economic scenarios
full.secZh: 将调查回答映射到模型隐含的经济情景

paras.en: In _Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI_ we introduced a structured framework for assessing how different future paths for AI capabilities and diffusion might translate into differences in economic outcomes. The model allows us to translate each respondent’s answers across five dimensions — capabilities, diffusion, automation, productivity, and worker transition frictions — into model-implied economic outcomes.5 Across both our US adult and Anthropic staff samples, we identify every respondent who answered all questions related to the key model inputs (3,259 US adults and 1,093 staff). We then evaluate the economic scenario implied by those answers for each respondent, focusing below on implications for GDP growth in 2030.
paras.zh: 在《变革性 AI 的经济情景》一文中，我们引入了一个结构化框架，用于评估 AI 能力与扩散的不同未来路径可能如何转化为经济结果的差异。该模型使我们能够将每位受访者在五个维度（能力、扩散、自动化、生产率以及劳动者转型摩擦）上的回答转化为模型隐含的经济结果。5 在我们的美国成年人样本和 Anthropic 员工样本中，我们识别出了所有回答了与关键模型输入相关的全部问题的受访者（3,259 名美国成年人和 1,093 名员工）。然后，我们针对每位受访者评估了这些回答所隐含的经济情景，下文重点讨论对 2030 年 GDP 增长的影响。

paras.en: The median US adult's answers imply GDP growth of 5.4% in 2030, according to the model. The median staff member's answers imply GDP growth accelerating to 17.1% by 2030. There is significant variation within each group, so the distributions overlap widely (Figure 7). Figure A1 in the appendix shows how much each belief contributes to this gap.
paras.zh: 根据该模型，美国成年人回答的中位数意味着 2030 年 GDP 增长率为 5.4%。员工回答的中位数则意味着到 2030 年 GDP 增长率将加速至 17.1%。每组内部存在显著差异，因此分布广泛重叠（图 7）。附录中的图 A1 展示了每种信念对这一差距的贡献程度。

full.sec: Responses from online scenario explorer quiz
full.secZh: 在线情景探索器测验的回应

paras.en: Figure 7 also shows the economic scenarios implied by inputs provided by site visitors to an interactive scenario explorer based on this economic model that was published at www.anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios on September 9, 2026.
paras.zh: 图 7 还展示了基于该经济模型的一个交互式情景探索器（于 2026 年 9 月 9 日发布在 www.anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios）的网站访客所提供的输入所隐含的经济情景。

paras.en: The interactive explorer asked shorter form versions of the questions we fielded to US adults and Anthropic staff in August 2026. 23,075 visitors completed the survey in the first 48 hours after publication, connecting from more than 140 countries worldwide. These visitors chose to come to a page on Anthropic's website and to take the quiz, so they are likely to be more interested in AI than the general public. Indeed, their answers place them between those of US adults and Anthropic staff: the median visitor's answers imply 12.5% growth.
paras.zh: 该交互式探索器询问了我们在 2026 年 8 月向美国成年人和 Anthropic 员工提出的问题的简版。在发布后的前 48 小时内，来自全球 140 多个国家的 23,075 名访客完成了调查。这些访客选择来到 Anthropic 网站的一个页面并参加测验，因此他们可能比普通公众对 AI 更感兴趣。事实上，他们的答案介于美国成年人和 Anthropic 员工之间：中位访客的答案意味着 12.5%的增长。

paras.en: **Model-implied GDP growth in 2030, based on the expectations of US adults, website visitors and Anthropic staff.** Each respondent's answers to the five questions on capabilities, adoption, autonomy, time savings, and re-employment are run through the model from Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI; see Appendix B therein for details. The thick bar spans the 25th to 75th percentile and the thin line the 10th to 90th percentile. Dotted lines mark three scenarios laid out in the paper: Modest (annual GDP growth of 2.4%), Substantial (5.4% GDP growth), and Extreme (15.4% GDP growth). The figure includes respondents who answered all five questions: 3,259 US adults (2030 half only), 1,093 Anthropic staff, and the 23,075 website visitors who completed the quiz available at anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios in the 48 hours after its launch on September 9, 2026.
paras.zh: **基于美国成年人、网站访客和 Anthropic 员工的预期，模型隐含的 2030 年 GDP 增长。** 每个受访者对能力、采用、自主性、时间节省和再就业五个问题的回答都通过《变革性 AI 的经济情景》中的模型运行；详情见该文附录 B。粗条表示第 25 至 75 百分位数，细线表示第 10 至 90 百分位数。虚线标出了论文中提出的三种情景：温和（年 GDP 增长 2.4%）、显著（GDP 增长 5.4%）和极端（GDP 增长 15.4%）。该图包括回答了所有五个问题的受访者：3,259 名美国成年人（仅 2030 年一半）、1,093 名 Anthropic 员工，以及在 2026 年 9 月 9 日发布后的 48 小时内完成 anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios 上测验的 23,075 名网站访客。

items.en: One reason staff are more optimistic about AI capabilities may be that they have greater visibility into the development process. The Anthropic Institute recently published a report on progress toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), a process where AI systems increasingly improve their own capabilities (Favaro and Clark, 2026).
items.zh: 员工对 AI 能力更为乐观的一个原因，可能是他们对开发过程有更深入的了解。Anthropic Institute 最近发布了一份关于递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement, RSI）进展的报告，RSI 是指 AI 系统不断改进自身能力的过程（Favaro and Clark, 2026）。

items.en: To shed light on whether staff themselves expect this to happen, we asked Anthropic staff what share of the work of building an early-2026 frontier model is done by AI today, and what they expect it to be in the future (Figure 8).6 Among surveyed Anthropic staff, the median answer today is 51%, 80% by the end of 2027 and 95% by the end of 2030.
items.zh: 为了解员工自身是否预期这一情况会发生，我们询问了 Anthropic 员工：如今构建一个 2026 年初的前沿模型，其工作有多大比例由 AI 完成，以及他们预期未来这一比例会是多少（图 8）。6 在接受调查的 Anthropic 员工中，当前比例的中位数为 51%，预计到 2027 年底为 80%，到 2030 年底为 95%。

items.en: Estimates of the share of work that AI does in AI development vary far more within teams than between them. Still, staff on research teams, who are closest to the work of building models, put AI's share today somewhat higher: 60% on average, against 53% for all other survey respondents. This is consistent with information playing some role, although researchers—by virtue of the nature of their work—may also use AI more in their own work than other employees.
items.zh: 对 AI 在 AI 研发中所完成工作比例的估计，在团队内部的差异远大于团队之间的差异。尽管如此，研究团队的员工——他们最接近构建模型的工作——认为当前 AI 所占比例略高：平均为 60%，而其他所有受访者为 53%。这与信息发挥一定作用的解释相符，不过研究人员——由于其工作性质——也可能比其他员工在自己的工作中更多地使用 AI。

items.en: As with the hiring forecasts, these responses are the personal views of staff members in an internal poll fielded to Anthropic staff in August 2026.
items.zh: 与招聘预测一样，这些回答是员工在 2026 年 8 月面向 Anthropic 员工开展的一项内部调查中的个人观点。

items.capEn: Anthropic staff's estimates of the share of the work of building a frontier model that is done by AI.** Anthropic staff were asked what share of the work of building an early-2026 frontier model is done by AI today, and what they expect that share to be at the end of 2027 and 2030. The tick marks the median answer, the boxes span 25th to 75th percentile, and the lines span 10th to 90th percentile. Answers are the personal estimates of staff members in an internal poll and are not a measurement by Anthropic or a company forecast.
items.capZh: Anthropic 员工对构建前沿模型工作中由 AI 完成份额的估计。** Anthropic 员工被问及当今 AI 完成 2026 年初前沿模型构建工作的份额，以及他们预计 2027 年底和 2030 年该份额。刻度线标记中位数答案，箱体跨 25 至 75 百分位，线跨 10 至 90 百分位。回答是员工在内部调查中的个人估计，并非 Anthropic 的测量或公司预测。

paras.en: US adults and Anthropic staff largely agree about what AI can do today. However, they disagree about how quickly it will improve, how widely it will be used, and how large the productivity gains measured by time saved will be. Through the lens of the model in Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI, the median US adult's answers imply a scenario in which the US economy grows at more than twice its typical rate. Among Anthropic staff working at the frontier of AI development and usage, expectations about AI progress, adoption, and automation of knowledge work imply a transformative and historically unprecedented change to the economy: by 2030, GDP is doubling in size roughly every four and a half years.
paras.zh: 美国成年人与 Anthropic 员工对当今 AI 能做什么大体上意见一致。然而，他们在 AI 将以多快速度改进、将被多广泛地使用，以及以节省时间衡量的生产率增益将有多大等问题上存在分歧。借助《变革性 AI 的经济情景》中的模型视角，美国成年人的中位回答所隐含的情景是：美国经济将以超过其典型增速两倍以上的速度增长。而在 AI 开发与使用前沿工作的 Anthropic 员工中，对 AI 进展、采用和知识工作自动化的预期则隐含着一场变革性的、史无前例的经济变化：到 2030 年，GDP 规模大约每四年半翻一番。

paras.en: Those who expect AI to do more of their own work in the years ahead expect higher unemployment as well. This is true for the general public in the US and among Anthropic employees; on average, Anthropic staff expect faster automation of their own work and, in turn, higher unemployment. We find that this disagreement in expectations is closely tied to differing views between Anthropic staff and the general public about how much of their own work will be automated in the years ahead.
paras.zh: 那些预期 AI 在未来几年承担自己更多工作的人，也预期更高的失业率。这一点对美国公众和 Anthropic 员工都成立；平均而言，Anthropic 员工预期自己工作的自动化速度更快，进而失业率更高。我们发现，这种预期上的分歧与 Anthropic 员工和公众之间在“未来几年自己多少工作将被自动化”这一问题上的看法差异密切相关。

paras.en: The day-to-day experience with AI varies widely between the two groups. Most Anthropic staff already work alongside AI that does much of their job, whereas few US workers do. Those who do already hold expectations closer to those of Anthropic staff, which suggests that public expectations may shift as AI use spreads. How far they shift will depend on whether AI comes to do as much of the work elsewhere as it does at a frontier lab.
paras.zh: 两个群体在日常使用 AI 的体验上差异很大。大多数 Anthropic 员工已经与承担其大部分工作的 AI 协同工作，而这样做的美国劳动者却很少。那些已经这样做的人，其预期已更接近 Anthropic 员工的预期，这表明随着 AI 使用的普及，公众预期可能会发生转变。转变幅度有多大，将取决于 AI 是否会在其他地方承担与在前沿实验室一样多的工作。
